name: Old Government House, Auckland
scope: Old Government House at the University of Auckland as represented by the 2008 exterior reference, including the lawn façade, attached wings, open inner court and mapped northeast portico. The neighboring university clock tower, gatekeeper cottage, lawns and interiors are outside this asset.

references.filename: Old Government House, University of Auckland.JPG

originalReview.notes: The lawn façade shows cream scored timber, ochre quoins and window surrounds, a tripartite arched sash, shallow curved pediment, roof balustrade, covered entry, and pale hipped side roofs. Vegetation partly obscures the ground floor. The Gothic tower visible behind the house is separate.

review.method: Qualla published original, exact Commons SHA-1 and creator public-domain dedication
review.notes: The 2008 exterior alone guides appearance. Earlier archival photos were left out of the dated reconstruction.
